cells.quote: Factorial analysis revealed both components independently increased AUC (Δ ≈ 0.05, P < 0.01) with a positive synergistic interaction (β = 0.021, P = 0.03), and cognitive load reduction was maximal when combined (Δ=–17.6, P = 0.01).
cells.note: The factorial design supplies the component-versus-absence contrast; the study text does not explicitly state the timing of the AUC assessment or learners' prior knowledge.
